prompt: A cinematic, wide-angle fantasy scene set in a desolate, barren rocky desert landscape under a soft, overcast sky. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a flowing, light-colored white dress, stands facing a massive, ancient, weathered circular stone portal that is embedded among the rocky terrain. The inside of the circular portal acts as a window or gateway revealing a stark contrast: a lush, vibrant green valley filled with rolling hills, dense forests, and meadows under a clear sky. In one variation, she is seated gracefully on a large rock right in front of the portal, and in another, she is standing barefoot on the dusty ground just outside the ring, looking outward into the verdant landscape. The composition emphasizes a surreal juxtaposition between an arid wasteland and a thriving paradise, captured with realistic textures, natural lighting, and a dreamy, atmospheric mood.
